title: Microservices Fundamentals
description: Understand the difference between monolithic and microservices architectures, their trade-offs, and when to use each approach.
longDescription: Learn the core concepts of microservices architecture, understand the differences from monolithic applications, and discover when microservices are the right choice for your system.
whatYouLearn: Distinguish between monolithic and microservices architectures
Apply decomposition strategies to break monoliths
